item.title: EU Open Sources Ten-Year Network Development Planning Tools
item.description:
📝 This repository is maintained using OET's soft-fork strategy. The model includes partial data from the TYNDP 2024 cycle, and its validation is ongoing. Repository structure benchmarks: will store snakemake benchmarks (does not exist initially) config: configurations used in the study cutouts: will store raw weather data cutouts from atlite (does not exist initially) data: includes input data that is not produced by any snakemake rule doc: includes all files necessary to build the readthedocs documentation of PyPSA-Eur envs: includes backup conda environments if pixi installation does not work.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/open-energy-transition/open-tyndp

item.title: Michigan bill would bar employers from requiring after-hours coms with workers
item.description:
📝 The bill is also known as the Workplace Employee Boundaries Act. " A bill analysis dated June 18 explains that an employee could be compensated in their contract for on-call availability. This includes emails, text messages or social media messages regarding employment duties or scheduling future work shifts, the bill analysis explains.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cbsnews.com/detroit/news/workplace-boundaries-act-employees-after-hours/

item.title: California legislature agrees to upload driver's licenses to national database
item.description:
📝 “Compliance” with the REAL-ID by California or any other state is optional, not required. Neither the Federal REAL-ID Act nor any other Federal law requires, or could require, California or any other state to share any data with AAMVA, a private nonprofit corporation. The Legislature should reject this “compromise” sell-out.
🔗 Read more: https://papersplease.org/wp/2026/06/27/california-legislature-agrees-to-upload-drivers-licenses-to-national-database/
